name: How does indoor rowing compare to other cardio exercises like running or cycling?
description: Rowing engages more muscles (85%) than running or cycling, offering full-body cardio and strength with lower joint impact.

mainEntity.name: How does indoor rowing compare to other cardio exercises like running or cycling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Indoor rowing stands out by simultaneously engaging over 85% of your muscles, providing both cardiovascular conditioning and strength training in one session, unlike running or cycling which are primarily lower-body focused. It's also non-weight bearing, reducing impact on joints compared to running. When choosing between these, consider your fitness goals and joint health. If you're looking for a comprehensive, low-impact workout, rowing offers a distinct advantage.
